name: Tanohata (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Tanohata village emblem in white: a ring crossed by a horizontal band with pointed ends.
history: Municipal flag of Tanohata, a village in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 December 1965.

features.role: Tanohata village emblem — a ring crossed by a horizontal band with pointed ends
